title: Failure-bit count for bounded family confidence
statement: For every positive integer $M$, if the confidence parameter is $1/(20M)$ and the failure-bit count is the base-two ceiling logarithm of the ceiling of twice the reciprocal of that parameter, then the count equals $\lceil\log_2(40M)\rceil$, with the ceiling logarithm understood as the least integer $k$ such that $2^k$ is at least its argument.
